title: peer instruct ai
tagline: on-chain peer-review to instruction-tune LLMs with better reasoning
description:
- a peer-review smart-contract inspired by the process of peer-reviewing of scientific publications
    - authors publish instruction-response
    - the smart contract finds most fitting 2-3 reviewers
    - reviewers vote if the data should be accepted
    - if the data is accepted, it goes on-chain
how_its_made:
solidity contract that selects reviewers and keeps track of voting
